description: This file defines internal interfaces and classes related to cancelling grain calls in Orleans. It includes the interface for handling cancellation requests, an interface for managing cancellations, and a class that implements the cancellation management by interacting with grain extensions.

classes.name: ExternalClientGrainCallCancellationManager
classes.description: Implements cancellation management for grain calls by invoking the CancelRequestAsync method on grain extensions.

methods.name: CancelRequestAsync
methods.description: Async method to cancel a grain call, indicated by message ID and sender grain ID.

methods.name: SignalCancellation
methods.description: Attempts to signal a cancellation for a specific grain call, optionally targeting a specific silo.
